snippet.title: The Phoenix Gene - Official Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Rewrite the Past. Save the Future. Get a closer look at the gameplay of The Phoenix Gene in this new trailer for the shooter ‘shmup. Learn about controls as you become a Slipstream Master! The Phoenix Gene is an adrenaline-fueled VR quest for immortality. Control a fierce phoenix, Firestorm, and genetically enhanced Jackie, bonded by fate and driven by the collapse of the Slipstream multiverse. The Phoenix Gene is available on Meta Quest.
